preservedSuccesses: V3 reduced predicted/reference run ratio from 2.176 to 1.360.
V3 reduced fragmented reference runs by about 60%.
V3 reduced mean end/duration absolute error by about 30%.
V3 improved event micro F1 and onset-only F1.
targetedRegressions: V3 exact true positives fell 12.7% aggregate.
V3 onset-only recall fell, dominated by P2->P1.
V3 activity false negatives and false positives both increased while total predicted active frames stayed nearly flat.
Pitch-correct wrong-string onset matches increased aggregate-wide.

architecture.reason: V3 produced a clear temporal-segmentation gain; the next evidence-supported step is to repair recall calibration and string routing before expanding architecture.

objective.base: per-string categorical cross-entropy over 20 fret classes plus silence, ignoring MASK

activeWeight.purpose: modestly restore active-reference pressure after V3 activity false negatives increased

contentWeighting.method: same bounded inverse-square-root weighting from training performance-group counts

continuityRegularizer.purpose: retain within-run stability that helped fragmentation

exactStringPitchEquivalentMargin.v4SemanticRepair: skip alternative pitch-equivalent positions when the alternative string's reference target is MASK or is itself exactly that same-pitch fret
exactStringPitchEquivalentMargin.purpose: penalize wrong-string routing without penalizing legitimate same-pitch multi-string reference notes

decoder.type: V3 hysteresis/gap scaffold plus bounded confirmed-start recovery
intent: preserve V3 fragmentation and duration gains
recover a low-confidence onset only when the same fret is confirmed on the next frame
preserve onset timing by back-admitting the first frame instead of delaying the start
continue rejecting isolated low-confidence single-frame spikes

syntheticVerificationRequirements: V4 active-reference default weighting is stronger than V3 while remaining bounded.
Reference-aware identity routing penalizes a wrong-string pitch equivalent.
Reference-aware identity routing does not penalize a legitimate same-pitch reference note on another string.
V3-style gap merge and singleton suppression remain intact.
A bounded two-frame confirmed low-confidence onset is admitted at its first frame.
An unconfirmed low-confidence spike remains rejected.
Strong true onset boundary remains preserved.
V4 objective produces finite gradients on exact pinned TabCNN runtime.
Uninterrupted and serialized-resumed TabCNN V4 synthetic optimization are bit-exact for model, optimizer and Python/NumPy/Torch RNG state.
nextGate: Dedicated V4 exact-runtime synthetic verification must pass before any request for real P1/P2 optimizer authorization.
